subject: Orchard Labs onboarding: PO issuance, spend cap & line item mapping
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Reed <l.reed@orchard-labs.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orchard Labs onboarding: PO routing and spend cap questions

Hi Lucas,

Thanks for starting the onboarding process with Redwood — excited to get Orchard Labs live. Quick items we need to close so procurement can issue a PO number cleanly:

- Completed onboarding form (we're missing the "preferred invoice format" and "primary remittance address")
- Vendor tax ID / W-9 (required to issue POs)
- Target monthly spend cap you'd like us to track (we can do provisional caps while finance completes account setup)
- Clarify SKU/line-item grouping — the intake form shows a bundle (Hardware Kit + Support hours) but our ledger needs separate line items to map ledger codes.

If you can attach the completed form and the W-9, Priyom will draft a provisional PO number and propose the line-item split for your review. Our usual timeline is 24–48 business hours after receiving the form and W-9.

Attachments: onboarding_form_template.pdf (blank)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Head of Procurement Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Lucas Reed <l.reed@orchard-labs.com>

Cc: Orchard Labs Procurement <procurement@orchard-labs.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orchard Labs onboarding: PO routing and spend cap questions

Hi Monica,

Thanks — attached are the completed onboarding form and our W-9. Apologies for the missing fields earlier; we filled the remittance address and selected "CSV invoices" as preferred.

Regarding spend: we're starting with a conservative provisional monthly cap of $35,000 while we run the initial pilot. Once usage patterns stabilize (2–3 weeks) we'll re-evaluate.

SKU split: the bundle is listed as one product in our sales quote. For ledgering purposes, would Redwood prefer two lines: (1) Hardware Kit (SKU: ORC-HWK) and (2) Implementation & Support hours (SKU: ORC-SVC)? That mapping works for our internal AP team.

Attached:
- orchard_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (completed)
- orchard_w9.pdf

Let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Lucas Reed
Head of Ops, Orchard Labs
l.reed@orchard-labs.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lucas Reed <l.reed@orchard-labs.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orchard Labs onboarding: PO routing and spend cap questions

Hi all — looping in ledger/finance (Logan) and proposing the following to unblock PO issuance quickly.

1) Provisional PO: we can issue a provisional PO number so your engineer team can begin provisioning. Proposed: PONUM-456-ORC (provisional).

2) Line-item mapping: to keep downstream billing and spend caps aligned, Priyom suggests two ledger lines: 
   - Line 1: ORC-HWK — "Hardware Kit" — quantity 1 — ledger code HWK-01 — unit price as per quote
   - Line 2: ORC-SVC — "Implementation & Support" — estimated hours/qty — ledger code SVC-07 — billable by usage

3) Spend cap: we'll set the provisional spend cap to $35,000/month as requested, with an automated alert at 80% utilization to notify both teams. If you hit the cap, we'll pause new provisioning and open a manual uplift flow.

4) Next actions: Lucas — confirm the two-line split and provide final unit prices/qtys (or confirm estimate is fine). Logan — will you confirm chart of accounts mapping and whether finance needs any further IDs to tie the PO to the vendor record?

Attachments: ponum-456-ORC.csv (provisional PO record with line mapping)

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Analyst
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Reed <l.reed@orchard-labs.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orchard Labs onboarding: PO routing and spend cap questions

Lucas — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Confirming Orchard agrees to the two-line split (ORC-HWK and ORC-SVC) and the provisional cap of $35,000/month. Unit pricing looks good to proceed on the estimate for now — we'll update if you provide exact qtys.

Priyom / Logan / Kimberly — please proceed to:
- Finalize issuance of PONUM-456-ORC as provisional (flag: provisional until vendor registration completes).
- Tag spend cap to that PO and enable 80% alert recipients: l.reed@orchard-labs.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, finance@redwood.com.
- Ensure accounting maps the two ledger codes (HWK-01, SVC-07) to vendor Orchard Labs so invoicing reconciles without manual line edits.

Lucas — once the PO is final in the system I will send a DocuSign for the standard supplier addendum (link will be posted to the HubSpot deal). Expect final confirmation by end of day tomorrow if finance has no outstanding blockers.

Thanks everyone — good momentum.

Monica Patel
